suppliers.name: Nexa Recursos Minerais
suppliers.evidence: Official product page offers LME-registered SHG zinc in ingots and jumbos. Batch origin, allocation, purity certificate and delivered quotation require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Brazil commercial office in Sao Paulo publishes frontoffice@nexaresources.com and a product enquiry form.

suppliers.name: Nexa Resources US
suppliers.evidence: US commercial office sells group SHG zinc ingots; this is not evidence of US smelting origin. Current batch availability and export terms require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Houston North America commercial office publishes sales.usa@nexaresources.com.

suppliers.name: Teck Metals
suppliers.evidence: Refined zinc product page describes SHG zinc and slab/jumbo forms from Trail, British Columbia. Specific lot purity, origin and allocation require a dated quotation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Canadian product enquiry form explicitly includes Zn: Special High Grade (SHG).

suppliers.name: Industrias Penoles
suppliers.evidence: Official zinc page lists minimum 99.995% SHG zinc. Slab format, quantity allocation, shipment origin and price require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Published client enquiry form accepts company, country and product of interest.

suppliers.name: Barsteel Corporation
suppliers.evidence: Official hot-rolled sheet and coil range includes carbon-steel specifications. Grade, coil dimensions, export eligibility and available tonnage require RFQ.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Highland Park, Illinois office publishes steel-product enquiry form and phone.

suppliers.name: Venture Steel Canada
suppliers.evidence: Official carbon flat-rolled range includes hot-rolled products. Full-coil dimensions, grade and origin require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Toronto office publishes request-a-quote route, form and phone.

suppliers.name: Venture Steel Mexico
suppliers.evidence: Official group carbon flat-rolled range includes hot rolled; Mexico facility is listed by the company. Local coil stock, exact specification and origin require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Ramos Arizpe, Coahuila facility and phone published alongside request-a-quote route.

suppliers.name: Colakoglu Metalurji
suppliers.evidence: Official product navigation lists hot-rolled flat steel coils. Grade, production slot and shipment origin must be specified in quotation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Istanbul headquarters and Kocaeli flat-products plant with department-selectable company enquiry form.

suppliers.name: Union Steel Trading
suppliers.evidence: Official range specifies hot-rolled coils/sheets at 1.2-12 mm and carbon structural grades including ASTM A36. Shipment origin and full-coil allocation remain unconfirmed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Doha office, info@unionsteelqatar.com and commercial phone numbers appear on product page.

suppliers.name: Rukan Saqib
suppliers.evidence: Official range lists hot-rolled coils/sheets at 1-12 mm in ASTM A36 and related grades. Specific stock, full-coil format and export terms need RFQ.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Riyadh office, product enquiries at info@rukansaqib.com and phone are published.

suppliers.name: Nucor Sheet Group
suppliers.evidence: Official page offers hot-rolled carbon sheet/coil and directs buyers to product-specific minimum order enquiries. Mill slot, grade, export arrangements and current price require quotation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Contact the Sheet Group route and customer purchasing portal are published on product page; Charlotte, North Carolina address.

suppliers.name: Ezz Steel
suppliers.evidence: Official range specifies HRC at 1-16 mm, 900-1600 mm wide, and 5.5-28 tonne coils. Current allocation, grade and delivery require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Cairo headquarters and Egyptian plants listed alongside product enquiry form.

suppliers.name: Qarmet
suppliers.evidence: Official HRC page specifies 1.5-12 mm by 860-1524 mm mill coils and 10-23 tonne coil weights. Dimensions and production feasibility must be agreed before contract.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Published application for production feasibility and regional wholesale sales contacts, including far-abroad sales.

suppliers.name: Kazzinc
suppliers.evidence: Official zinc page lists TsV0 at 99.995% minimum, but surrounding production figures are from 2019. Ingot format, current plant allocation and batch certificate require confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Zinc is listed for sales with Ust-Kamenogorsk front-office phone and kazzinc@kazzinc.com; no order response verified.

suppliers.name: BlueScope Steel
suppliers.evidence: Official HRC page lists low/medium-carbon, structural and formable coil grades. The page explicitly requires checking availability for each thickness-width combination.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Australian Steel Direct product enquiry email and Wollongong address published.

suppliers.name: Unique Procurement Services
suppliers.evidence: Official page advertises zinc-ingot trading but does not specify minimum SHG purity. Do not treat as grade-qualified; obtain 99.995% certificate, actual seller identity and firm quotation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Victoria address, sales@uniqueprocurement.com and quote route published.

suppliers.name: Saffron Steel
suppliers.evidence: Official page offers Nippon HRC and publishes Jebel Ali trading enquiries. Undated ready-stock claims and regional delivery descriptions are not confirmed allocation or transit commitments.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Dubai office, info@saffronsteel.ae and request-quote instructions specify thickness, width, tonnage and destination.

suppliers.name: Al Taher Chemicals
suppliers.evidence: Official metals page supplies zinc ingots and describes SHG as 99.995% purity. A batch-specific certificate is needed because explanatory purity text is not a current lot guarantee.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Ajman address and RFQ form with quantity and product fields published.

suppliers.name: Nit Metal
suppliers.evidence: Official page advertises minimum 99.995% SHG zinc-ingot trading, but its displayed impurity table is inconsistent with that purity. Hold grade qualification until a corrected specification and independent batch certificate are received.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Istanbul office and buying/selling offer forms with quantity, payment and delivery-term fields published.

suppliers.name: Al-Nafie Steel
suppliers.evidence: Commercial range lists hot-rolled plates and coils separately from stainless products. Exact carbon-steel grade, coil stock, dimensions and export origin need quotation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Jeddah headquarters with info@alnafie-steel.com and regional offices; page displays modification timestamp 2026-05-21.

suppliers.name: Companhia Siderurgica Nacional
suppliers.evidence: Official HRC specification page lists carbon and structural grades but explicitly says last updated 2020-12-22. Retained only as historical product capability, not present specification or stock confirmation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Current steel-sales/customer-service channel publishes atendimento@csn.com.br and Brazil factory/office addresses.

suppliers.name: Metinvest Holding
suppliers.evidence: Official page offers HRC through group sales channels; Ukrainian office does not establish shipment origin. Plant operating status, route availability and trade-compliance eligibility remain unconfirmed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Published sales enquiry route and Kyiv office; no order acceptance or export eligibility verified.

suppliers.name: Chelyabinsk Zinc Plant
suppliers.evidence: Official product catalogue lists metallic zinc in 19-25 kg ingots; sales site describes at least 99.995% purity. Operating status, trade-compliance eligibility and specific lot availability remain unconfirmed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Chelyabinsk address and dedicated zinc/alloys commercial contact published; no order acceptance or export eligibility verified.

suppliers.name: Macsteel Coil Processing
suppliers.evidence: Official range offers hot-rolled carbon sheets cut from coil. Full unprocessed coil supply is not confirmed on this page; treat as a product-family lead requiring RFQ.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Boksburg, South Africa address and sales enquiry form/phone published.

suppliers.name: DBMSC-Steel Oman
suppliers.evidence: Official group flats page offers hot-rolled coils separately from stainless products. Confirm carbon grade, local allocation and origin before qualification.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Contact page lists Muscat and publishes group sales@dbmscsteel.ae; company history independently names DBMSC-Steel LLC Oman. Local address fields repeat Dubai headquarters, so obtain current Oman contracting and dispatch details.

suppliers.name: DBMSC Steel Trading Bahrain
suppliers.evidence: Official group flats page advertises hot-rolled coils separately from stainless products. Confirm carbon grade, Bahrain allocation and actual origin by RFQ.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Contact page lists Bahrain Tubli and group sales@dbmscsteel.ae; company history names DBMSC Steel Trading WLL in Manama. Repeated Dubai address fields require reconfirmation of the local contracting and dispatch entity.

suppliers.name: NLMK
suppliers.evidence: Official construction-products site specifies hot-rolled commercial and structural steel coils up to 36 tonnes. Operating status, destination-specific trade compliance, bank acceptance and shipping availability remain unconfirmed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Official contacts identify Lipetsk and Moscow locations and sales call centre; the product site publishes sales@nlmk.com and a request form. Inclusion is not confirmation of eligible exports or order acceptance.

suppliers.name: Zinc Egypt
suppliers.evidence: Official product page advertises special-high-grade zinc ingots. Numeric chemistry limits, lot certificate, capacity, legal entity and current allocation must be independently confirmed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Sales page publishes zincinfo@zincegypt.com, +20 120 200 3091 and Egyptian factory/sales locations; contact form also inspected. Undated repeat-purchase/cash discount policy has no published percentage or firm quantity tier.

suppliers.name: M.R. Zinc
suppliers.evidence: Official metals page expressly supplies virgin SHG zinc as well as other grades. Ingot format and a minimum 99.995% batch certificate remain unconfirmed, so this is a product-family lead.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Official export page identifies a South African company and publishes a name/email/subject/message enquiry form. The stated export product list does not itself confirm SHG ingot exports.

suppliers.name: Gulf for Metal Alloys
suppliers.evidence: Official products list supplies zinc ingots to steel, foundry and galvanizing customers. SHG purity is not specified and must not be assumed.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Published sales@gulfmetalsksa.com, +966 549258313 and Al-Kharj Industrial Area warehouse in Saudi Arabia. No live allocation or quote verified.

suppliers.name: AluMin Trading WLL
suppliers.evidence: Official primary non-ferrous product section offers zinc ingots. Numeric SHG purity is not published; obtain a compliant lot certificate and quotation.
suppliers.contact_evidence: Doha address, Qatar phone, info@alumintrading.com and a product-selectable enquiry form are published. Headquarters location does not establish origin or present inventory.
